description: Iran frees journalist Cecilia Sala after 21 days, linked to Italy’s detention of an Iranian engineer.
Trump signs NSPM-2 reinstating the ‘maximum pressure’ campaign on Iran.
First indirect US–Iran nuclear talks held in Muscat (Witkoff / Araghchi).
Second round of indirect nuclear talks held in Rome.
UK arrests several Iranian men over a suspected Iran-linked attack plot.
Oman-brokered US–Houthi ceasefire halts US strikes in Yemen.
Nuclear talks rounds 4–5 (Muscat 11 May, Rome 23 May) deadlock on enrichment.
Israel intercepts the Madleen aid vessel (Greta Thunberg aboard) in international waters.
IAEA Board finds Iran in non-proliferation breach — first such finding in ~20 years.
Operation Rising Lion: 200+ aircraft strike Natanz/Fordow/Isfahan, airbases and Parchin — start of the 12-day war.
Operation True Promise III: ~150 ballistic missiles and 100+ drones fired at Israel.
Israel strikes Tehran Defence Ministry, missile-storage sites and fuel depots.
Sustained Iranian ballistic barrages on Tel Aviv, Bat Yam and Rehovot.
Operation Midnight Hammer: 7 B-2s drop 14 GBU-57 on Fordow/Natanz; ~30 Tomahawks on Isfahan.
Iran fires ~14 missiles at Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar (pre-warned; 13 intercepted, no casualties).
Houthis break the May ceasefire, sinking the Magic Seas and resuming Red Sea attacks.
14-nation joint statement condemns a surge in Iranian assassination and kidnapping plots abroad.
Australia expels Iran’s ambassador after ASIO ties the IRGC to 2024 antisemitic arson — first expulsion since WWII.
The E3 trigger the JCPOA snapback mechanism, starting a 30-day countdown to reimpose UN sanctions.
UN Security Council rejects a sanctions-relief extension (4–9–2), locking in snapback.
Pre-2015 UN sanctions snap back into force; the EU reimposes its restrictive measures on 29 Sep.
French detainees Kohler & Paris released from prison but barred from leaving (exact day unconfirmed ⚠).
Australia lists the IRGC as a state sponsor of terrorism and imposes new sanctions.
Nationwide protests erupt over the rial’s collapse and ~42% inflation; a mass crackdown follows.
Protest crackdown peaks amid an internet shutdown; security forces fire on crowds.
Operation Epic Fury: ~900 US strikes in 12h; Supreme Leader Khamenei and senior officials killed — second war begins.
Iran fires ~170 ballistic missiles at Israel and US bases (Al Udeid, Ali Al Salem, Al Dhafra, 5th Fleet HQ Bahrain).
A round of US–Iran talks in Muscat reports progress the same day the war begins.
Sustained joint strikes on Natanz, command HQs and the state broadcaster.
Iran strikes Israel and Gulf states; ~10 vessels hit in the Strait of Hormuz; a drone hits RAF Akrotiri.
Pakistan brokers a conditional two-week US–Iran ceasefire toward a lasting agreement.
Trump says a deal reopening the Strait of Hormuz is ‘largely negotiated.’
US ‘self-defense’ strikes hit two IRGC mine-laying boats and a Bandar Abbas SAM site; Iran calls it a ceasefire violation.
IAEA Board of Governors issues safeguards report (GOV/2026/33) and Western nations draft resolution calling on Iran to restart nuclear cooperation and provide information on enriched uranium stores
CENTCOM shoots down four Iranian one-way attack drones launched toward Strait of Hormuz and strikes Iranian coastal surveillance radar sites at Goruk and on Qeshm Island
Iran fires seven ballistic missiles at US-aligned bases in Kuwait and Bahrain; six intercepted by US and Bahraini air defenses, seventh fails to reach target
Israel strikes Beirut's southern Dahieh suburb, killing two and wounding eleven — first Israeli strike on Lebanese capital since ceasefire renewal
Iran launches ballistic missiles at Israel targeting Ramat David Airbase; Israel says all intercepted, Iran claims base was damaged
Israel retaliates with strikes on military targets in western and central Iran including Mahshahr petrochemical complex in Khuzestan Province, defying Trump's phone call urging restraint
EU imposes first-ever freedom-of-navigation sanctions on IRGC Navy's Hormozgan Provincial Command and two Iranian officials over Strait of Hormuz blockade

US launches new round of airstrikes on multiple targets in Iran including surveillance capabilities, communications, air defense sites, a manufacturing complex, barracks and IRGC base near Tehran and Bandar Abbas
Iran retaliates with strikes against US base in Jordan and 21 other targets in Gulf states; Jordan intercepts 20 missiles near base hosting US troops
US and Iran agree to new 60-day ceasefire conditions mediated by Pakistan and Qatar, paving the way for an MOU signing
Israeli air raids across southern Lebanon kill at least five including Ar-Rihan municipality mayor Ali Badie; continued Israeli operations despite ceasefire
Mediators announce MOU framework agreed; Pakistan PM Sharif announces US and Iran have reached a deal for immediate and permanent end to conflict

Trump signs MOU at Palace of Versailles during G7; Pezeshkian signs electronically in Tehran. 60-day ceasefire extended, Strait of Hormuz to reopen, Iran agrees to dilute HEU stockpile and nuclear talks to follow
Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei publicly authorizes the MOU despite stating he had 'a different opinion'; endorses direct negotiations with US while warning against additional American demands
US lifts naval blockade of Iranian ports; Iran begins reopening Strait of Hormuz to commercial traffic; Saudi supertankers begin transiting the strait

Vance-led US delegation meets Iran's Ghalibaf and Araghchi at Bürgenstock resort, Switzerland for implementation talks; Trump threatens to resume bombing and 'take over' Hormuz, temporarily disrupting talks; mediators report 'encouraging progress'
Iran announces closure of Strait of Hormuz again in response to latest Israeli strikes in Lebanon, adding new tensions during Switzerland talks
Indirect US-Iran talks in Doha; VP Vance says talks 'going well'; Qatar and Pakistan report 'positive progress' on MOU issues.

Multi-day funeral procession for slain Supreme Leader Khamenei begins (Jul 4-9, Tehran to Qom to Mashhad). Millions mourn; successor Mojtaba Khamenei does not appear publicly, fueling leadership uncertainty.
source: CNN Jul 4; CNBC Jul 5; Al Jazeera Jul 5-6

description: Iran attacks three commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Jul 6-7, violating the June MOU and triggering US retaliation.
source: Britannica; CNN Jul 7; ABC News timeline

description: US launches 'series of powerful strikes' hitting 80+ targets across Iran (maritime, missile storage, air-defense sites). CENTCOM statement confirms operation.
source: CNN Jul 7 live blog; CENTCOM statement

description: Trump administration reimposed sanctions on Iranian oil and petrochemical sales, reversing the 60-day sanctions lift agreed in June MOU.
NATO Ankara Summit opens (Jul 7-8); Iran war dominates agenda; Trump declares ceasefire 'over' at closing press conference Jul 8.
source: NATO.int; NPR Jul 8; Al Jazeera Jul 7

description: IRGC strikes a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz; Iran declares the waterway closed 'until further notice.'
source: CNN Jul 11; Bloomberg Jul 11; Al Jazeera Jul 11; CTV News

description: Iran strikes and disables two UAE-flagged tankers in Omani territorial waters in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member.
source: CNN Jul 13 live blog; CNBC Jul 13

description: UK proscribes IRGC and linked groups as terrorist organizations; support now punishable by up to 14 years in prison.
source: Reuters Jul 13; Sky News; Global Banking & Finance

description: Starmer says 'I utterly condemn Iran's strikes on commercial shipping and on our Gulf partners. These attacks must stop'; calls for urgent ceasefire resumption.
IRGC claims strikes on US military assets in Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Jordan, and Syria in widening regional attacks.
Iranian ballistic-missile and drone attack on US airbase in Jordan kills two US soldiers (James Feehan, 25; Isabella Gonzales, 19) — first US combat deaths of the war.
source: NBC News Jul 18; PBS Jul 20; Axios Jul 18

description: Houthis attack two Saudi oil tankers (Encelia and Layla) in the Red Sea, threatening shipments from Saudi Arabia's Yanbu port.
source: Al Jazeera Jul 22; Spectrum News Jul 23

description: Iran fires six ballistic missiles at Jordan's Aqaba; US defenses intercept four; Iron Dome engages debris over Eilat. CENTCOM completes 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iran.
source: GlobalSecurity.org daily calendar; US News Jul 23

description: Houthis claim missile and drone attacks on Saudi oil refinery and southern Saudi Arabia in response to Saudi strikes on Hodeida — first such attacks since 2022.
source: Washington Post Jul 25; Bloomberg Jul 25; AP Jul 25

description: Ukraine strikes Iranian commercial vessel in Caspian Sea, killing one sailor; Kyiv says ship carried drone/missile components bound for Iran. Iran condemns attack as 'hostile and criminal'; Zelenskyy hails 'very strong results.'
source: UPI Jul 26; Al Jazeera Jul 25; Jerusalem Post Jul 26

description: US does not announce new strikes for first time in two weeks, signaling a pause. By Jul 26, pause holds for second day; UN envoy Waltz says Trump giving talks 'some space.'
source: CNN Jul 25; CNN Jul 26; Al Jazeera Jul 26

description: Netanyahu tells Fox News the Iran war will end 'when the Iranian regime falls, or weakens to such an extent that it understands it must end its nuclear program.'
source: Jerusalem Post Jul 26; Times of Israel Jul 26
